person_note: The base narration is third person: the diagnostic quotes use external family-history and scene narration, while the conspicuous first-person passage in q00235 is explicitly framed as a character's direct thought. The sustained opening independently shows the same external technique, and scholarly whole-book analysis calls the novel heterodiegetic across its five books and epilogue. No evidence indicates sustained first- or second-person base sections; the main limitation is that the accessible primary-text sample covers only the opening.
